text:
Sanjay (Presales): Need a bite-sized POC playbook for a quick customer demo tomorrow: streaming SDK examples (Node + Go), function/tool-call pattern, structured JSON output check, handshake cURL, and a one-paragraph security summary (KMS, retention, SOC2 link). Can someone put together a <1 page cheat and drop here?

Eve (Eng): I can assemble. Confirm region (eu-west) and ephemeral creds required? Also they asked for a cheap fallback model in case of bursts?

Rita (Sales): Yes EU, ephemeral creds preferred, fallback to quantized small variant is fine. Finance will fill pricing placeholders.

Sanjay (Presales): Perfect. Keep samples minimal. Also add 3 quick troubleshooting bullets: 401 -> bad token, handshake stall -> missing Accept header, tool calls failing -> webhook rejects TLS.

Eve (Eng): Draft (compact):
- Objective: demo streaming chat + function calls + structured output validation.
- Env: Hosted (eu), primary model: r-infer-2, fallback: r-infer-2-quant-small.
- Auth: API key or short-lived token. KMS for key storage, TLS required. Logs not retained by default; can be enabled with consent. SOC2: link will be added by legal.

Node snippet:
```js
const c = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, region: 'eu' });
const s = c.chat.stream({ model: 'r-infer-2' });
s.on('event', e => {
  if (e.type === 'function_call') fetch('https://hook/call', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(e.payload) });
  if (e.type === 'message') console.log(e.message);
});
```
Go snippet:
```go
cli := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("RW_KEY"))
stream := cli.ChatStream(ctx, redwood.ChatParams{Model: "r-infer-2"})
for ev := range stream.Events() {
  if ev.Type == redwood.EventFunctionCall {
    http.Post("https://hook/call", "application/json", bytes.NewReader(ev.Payload))
  }
}
```
Handshake cURL:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" -H "Accept: text/event-stream" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams/chat?model=r-infer-2&region=eu"
```
Structured output: validate against a small JSON Schema on receive, e.g. '{"type":"object","properties":{"intent":{"type":"string"},"items":{"type":"array"}}}'. Recommend SDK schema hook.

Operational knobs: batching window 10-20ms, KV prefix cache enabled. Fallback when queue latency >80ms or GPU util >75% -> route to quantized small.

Troubleshooting: 1) 401: check token/KMS rotation and clock skew; 2) SSE stalls: ensure Accept header + CORS; 3) Tool calls fail: webhook TLS, IP allowlist.

Eve (Eng): Posting the file to the shared drive and tagging legal/finance for SOC2/pricing.

Rita (Sales): I'll ping finance and legal, will update placeholders. Tag me when final.

infra-bot: Template used: presales/quick-playbook-template v1.2."
